name: How long does professional trim installation typically take for a house?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional trim installation typically take for a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of trim installation varies based on the scope of the project, the complexity of the trim profiles, and the size of your home. For a standard 1,500-2,000 square foot house, installing baseboards and door/window casing in a few rooms might take 2-4 days. Adding crown molding or more intricate designs can extend the timeline. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring precision and quality. We provide a detailed project timeline during our initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim installation time varies by project size and complexity, but typically ranges from a few days to over a week for an entire house.
